title: HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free
desc:
During an upload, curl mishandles HTTP/2 `RST_STREAM` received from the server
(with reason `HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED` or `REFUSED_STREAM`) leading to a use after
free of a `struct Curl_easy` object.

title: Quadratic complexity in WordDecoder.DecodeHeader in mime
desc: Decoding a maliciously-crafted MIME header containing many invalid encoded-words can consume excessive CPU.

title: An issue was discovered in HAProxy before 3.3.6. The HTTP/3 parser does not check that the received body length matches
desc: An issue was discovered in HAProxy before 3.3.6. The HTTP/3 parser does not check that the received body length matches a previously announced content-length when the stream is closed via a frame with an empty payload. This can cause desynchronization issues with the backend server and could be used for request smuggling. The earliest affected version is 2.6.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes a routing-daemon crash when BGP ISO-VPN egress protection is enabled
desc: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the rpd routing daemon of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated configured BGP peer to cause a denial of service via a BGP UPDATE when ISO-VPN and egress-protection configuration is enabled.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes an rpd crash when routing-policy resolution-map processing and policy event tracing are enabled
desc: A NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows a configured BGP neighbor to cause a denial of service via a BGP route update when specific routing-policy resolution-map and policy event-tracing configuration is enabled.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes rpd denial of service when EVPN route signaling is used
desc: An Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) process of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to cause a denial of service via a malformed EVPN Type-3 or Type-4 route received from a configured EVPN peer and processed during re-advertisement.

title: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: An attacker causes rpd crash and denial of service when EVPN is configured
desc: An Improper Input Validation vulnerability in the routing protocol daemon (rpd) of Juniper Networks Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to cause a denial of service via a crafted BGP EVPN update message.

title: svg-sanitizer: Mixed-case xlink:HrEf skips the `<use>` nesting-DoS check in Resolver::processReferences
desc: svg-sanitizer is a PHP SVG/XML sanitizer. Prior to 1.0.0, Resolver::processReferences() in src/ElementReference/Resolver.php builds the SVG <use> reference graph with a case-sensitive href attribute predicate before cleanHrefAttributes() normalizes mixed-case names. title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Missing Authorization via deleteGroup API
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController::deleteGroup() that omits privilege-level checks on target groups. Authenticated non-SuperAdmin administrators holding GROUP_DELETE can send a crafted groupId to /admin/api/group/delete to permanently destroy higher-privileged groups and strip members' inherited rights.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta 2FA Brute-Force via remove-twofactor Endpoint
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta lacks brute-force lockout in the removeTwofactorConfig() 2FA removal endpoint, allowing authenticated attackers to guess TOTP codes without limit. Attackers holding a hijacked session and CSRF token can repeatedly POST guesses to /api/user/remove-twofactor to permanently disable the victim's 2FA.

title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Account Enumeration via Guest Comment Endpoint
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to confirm registered display names and emails via a distinct HTTP 409 response. Attackers can submit guest comments to the comment create endpoint with candidate user and mail values to link names to emails for targeted phishing.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta Missing Authorization via Admin Dashboard
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.1.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the admin dashboard that allows authenticated users without admin rights to view restricted data. Attackers with any activated account can request /admin/index.php/ to read unpublished FAQ questions, admin edit URLs, recent user identities, and site statistics.

title: Epic Games Unreal Engine Insecure Default URL Scheme Allowance in LaunchURL
desc: Epic Games Unreal Engine versions up to and including 5.8.0 ship with an insecure default configuration for the LaunchURL Blueprint node (UKismetSystemLibrary::LaunchURL). The URL scheme filter (FURLRequestFilter) is empty by default, which permits all URL schemes. title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output in Crafty Controller
desc: An output escaping vulnerability in the Audit Logs component of Crafty Controller allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to perform stored cross-site scripting via HTTP header injection

title: Gitea GitLab migration denial of service
desc: Gitea's initial GitLab migration version probe uses an HTTP client without a timeout and does not attach the migration task's cancellation context. An authenticated user who can start migrations can target an attacker-controlled server that keeps the response open indefinitely. desc: Gitea's organization repository-creation API requires write:organization but omits the write:repository token scope enforced by other repository-creation routes. A personal access token or OAuth application token without repository-write scope can therefore create organization-owned repositories if the authorizing user has permission to do so. title: Gitea second-factor bypass through OpenID identity linking
desc: Gitea's OpenID connect handler accepts a user's password without enforcing enrolled TOTP or WebAuthn verification before completing sign-in and linking an OpenID identifier. When OpenID sign-in is enabled, an attacker who knows the victim's password can obtain a session and link an attacker-controlled identifier. The attacker can then sign in through that identifier without the victim's password o

title: Gitea external renderer argument injection and code execution
desc: Gitea substitutes a URL derived from the markup Context field into external renderer command templates without escaping the reference path before shell-style argument splitting. A crafted Context can inject additional renderer arguments, including options that load executable filter files. title: Gitea reusable workflow secret exposure in pull_request_target
desc: Gitea resolves local reusable workflow files from a fork's head commit when a trusted base-branch workflow runs for a pull_request_target event. A fork author can modify a referenced reusable workflow so attacker-controlled code executes with the repository and organization secrets available to that event. title: Gitea Runner host isolation bypass through container options
desc: Gitea Runner passes workflow-controlled container options into Docker job container configuration while privileged mode is disabled. Host namespace settings, expanded capabilities, and security profile overrides can remain effective despite Privileged being forced false. A workflow author able to run jobs on an affected Docker-backed runner can use these options to access host namespaces and execu

title: Gitea API token scope escalation through HTTP signatures
desc: Gitea allows a token with write:user scope to register an attacker-controlled SSH public key on the token owner's account. API requests signed with the corresponding private key authenticate as that account through HTTP Signature without API token scope information, causing route-level token scope checks to be skipped. This converts a user-scoped token into an unscoped API authentication method wh

title: Gitea repository ownership escalation by administrators
desc: Gitea's collaboration access-mode endpoint accepts the Owner access mode from an authenticated repository collaborator with Admin access. The collaborator can promote their effective permissions from Admin to Owner and then perform owner-only operations, including transferring the repository to their own account. This bypasses the intended boundary between repository administration and ownership.

title: Dell Terraform Provider for Redfish, versions 1.1.0 through 1.6.1, contains an Exposure of Sensitive Information to an U
desc: Dell Terraform Provider for Redfish, versions 1.1.0 through 1.6.1, contains an Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability in the redfish_certificate resource component. A high privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

title: Gitea blind SSRF through OpenID assertion verification
desc: When OpenID sign-in is enabled, Gitea processes unauthenticated assertion parameters and sends an HTTP POST request to the caller-supplied OpenID provider endpoint during verification. An attacker controls the destination and much of the form body, allowing interaction with internal HTTP services reachable from the Gitea server. title: Gitea private attachment disclosure through repository mismatch
desc: Gitea's web attachment handler skips its cross-repository ownership check for attachments created before 16 January 2026 and checks permissions against the repository named in the request URL instead. An unauthenticated attacker who knows a private attachment's UUID can request it through a public repository's attachment path and retrieve its contents. desc:
Insecure Temporary File vulnerability in Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX and Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server.

desc: OpenVPN 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.7 allows remote authenticated users to impersonate others via a crafted certificate subject field

desc:
Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX and Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server.

This issue affects Hitachi Disk Array Driver for AIX: from 01-00 before 01-23-/A; Hitachi Disk Array Driver for Virtual I/O Server: from 01-04 before 01-23-/A.

title: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource in lomiri-download-manager
desc: Incorrect DBus policy for lomiri-upload-manager (part of lomiri-download-manager) allows arbitrary user to read arbitrary file as root over DBus

title: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource in lomiri-download-manager
desc: Incorrect DBus policy for lomiri-download-manager allows arbitrary user to run arbitrary command as root over DBus

title: Frappe before 13.22.0 Improper Authorization via Document Rename
desc: Frappe before 13.22.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to rename documents by exploiting a missing permission check. Attackers can invoke the document rename functionality on documents they lack permission to modify, altering records without proper authorization.

title: Frappe before 15.91.1 Stored XSS via Leaderboard User Names
desc: Frappe before 14.99.10 and 15.x before 15.91.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the leaderboard page because user names are rendered without proper neutralization. Authenticated attackers can set a crafted user name that executes arbitrary JavaScript in the browsers of other users who view the leaderboard.

title: Immich through 3.3.1 Missing Authorization in Partner Sync Exposes Locked Folder Metadata
desc: Immich through 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the partner synchronization stream that allows authenticated partners to read Locked Folder asset metadata because sync queries do not exclude Locked visibility. Attackers with an active partner relationship can call POST /api/sync/stream with PartnerAssetsV2 and PartnerAssetExifsV1 types to obtain GPS coordinates, capture time

title: AstronRPA through 1.1.6 Cross-Tenant Shared Variable Disclosure via get-batch-shared-var
desc: AstronRPA through 1.1.6 contains a missing tenant authorization check in robot-service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' shared variables via the get-batch-shared-var endpoint. Attackers can enumerate sequential shared variable IDs and decrypt all-users variables re-encrypted with their own tenant key to recover other tenants' credentials in plaintext.

title: OpenRefine through 3.10.1 CSRF to RCE via get-rows Command
desc: OpenRefine through 3.10.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the get-rows command that allows remote attackers to execute Jython facet expressions. Attackers can lure a user to a malicious page issuing a cross-origin GET with a crafted engine parameter, executing operating system commands as the OpenRefine user.

title: Octop through 1.0.2b6 Missing Authorization Exposes Provider API Keys via /api/providers
desc: TencentCloud Octop through 1.0.2b6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read stored provider API keys via GET /api/providers and GET /api/voice/providers. Attackers can query these endpoints, which only validate the JWT, to obtain plaintext LLM and voice provider API keys and abuse the upstream provider accounts.

title: InnoShop 0.9.2 Local File Disclosure via AI Core MCP file_upload Tool
desc: InnoShop 0.9.2 contains a local file disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators with files_create permission to read server files by abusing the AI Core MCP file_upload tool's source argument. Attackers can supply file:// or php:// stream wrappers passed to file_get_contents(), storing contents on the public media disk to expose the .env file with APP_KEY and database creden

title: OpenLIT 2.1.0 Authorization Bypass via x-openlit-project-id Header
desc: OpenLIT 2.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other projects' telemetry by supplying a forged x-openlit-project-id header. Attackers who know a victim project id and database config id can query the trace read API to obtain traces including LLM prompts and completions.

title: Helicone through v2025.08.21-1 SSRF via Jawn Webhook Sender DNS Resolution
desc: Helicone through v2025.08.21-1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Jawn webhook sender that allows authenticated organization users to reach internal services by using hostnames resolving to private addresses. Attackers can create webhooks with public hostnames that resolve or DNS-rebind to loopback or internal addresses, causing blind POST requests to internal HTTPS servic

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 IDOR via deleteVideoRecord userId Parameter
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' AI video generation records by supplying arbitrary userId values to DELETE /airag/video/deleteVideoRecord. Attackers can obtain record ids from the unchecked GET /airag/video/listByUser endpoint and delete victims' Redis-stored video history entries one record p

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/word/deleteBatch
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the AigcWordTemplateController deleteBatch handler that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete word templates. Attackers can send a DELETE request to /airag/word/deleteBatch with comma-separated ids to permanently delete any templates in the shared library.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysMessageTemplate/add Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to create message templates by calling POST /sys/message/sysMessageTemplate/add. Attackers holding only minimal roles can insert arbitrary notification templates with chosen codes and content into the shared sys_sms_template library used for system, e-mail, SMS and IM notifications

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/log/delete Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysLogController delete handler that allows any authenticated user to delete audit log entries. Low-privileged attackers can obtain log ids from the unguarded /sys/log/list endpoint and delete chosen sys_log records to erase traces of their actions.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/role/datarule Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the loadDatarule handler of SysRoleController that lets any authenticated user query role data rules. Low-privileged attackers can request GET /sys/role/datarule/{permissionId}/{roleId} to read rule names, columns, conditions, values and bound rule ids for any role.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysDepartPermission queryById Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysDepartPermissionController queryById handler that allows any authenticated user to read department permission records. Low-privileged attackers can request GET /sys/sysDepartPermission/queryById with arbitrary ids to retrieve depart_id, permission_id and data_rule_ids for any department.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via deleteUserGroupBatch Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to remove user group members by calling DELETE /sys/user/deleteUserGroupBatch. Attackers can supply any groupId and comma-separated userIds to delete sys_ugroup_user rows without permission or tenant checks, tampering with administrator-maintained groups.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 IDOR via PUT /sys/sysAnnouncementSend/edit
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SysAnnouncementSendController that allows authenticated users to modify other users' message delivery records. Attackers can obtain delivery ids from GET /sys/sysAnnouncementSend/list and submit edit requests that overwrite read flags, recipient ids, or linked announcements to hide messages from recipients.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/checkRule/importExcel
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to create validation rules through the SysCheckRuleController importExcel handler. Attackers can upload a crafted Excel workbook to bypass the system:checkRule:add permission and bulk-create system-wide encoding validation rules with arbitrary regular expression patterns.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/api/updateAvatar
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SystemApiController updateAvatar handler that allows any authenticated user to change other users' avatars. Low-privileged attackers can send PUT requests with a target user id and an arbitrary value, such as an attacker-controlled image URL, to replace administrators' avatars.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/tenant/passApply
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysTenantController passApply handler that allows any authenticated user to approve tenant administrator applications. Attackers can file a pending application via doApplyTenantPackUser and approve it through PUT /sys/tenant/passApply to gain tenant administrator pack permissions in any tenant.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/tenant/deleteTenantPackUser
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to remove users from tenant product packs via PUT /sys/tenant/deleteTenantPackUser. Attackers can supply arbitrary userId and packId values in the request body to remove any user from any tenant's product pack, revoking permissions such as tenant administrator access.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /airag/prompts/revertRecycleBin
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to restore deleted AI prompt templates by calling the revertRecycleBin endpoint. Attackers can send PUT requests to /airag/prompts/revertRecycleBin with chosen template ids to clear deleted flags, undoing administrator removals.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Authorization Bypass via /airag/video/listByUser
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the getVideoRecords handler of VideoGenerationController that allows authenticated users to read other users' records via the userId parameter. Low-privileged attackers can supply another user id to retrieve their AI video generation history, including prompts, task ids, video URLs and cover URLs.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/api/getUserByName
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GET /sys/api/getUserByName that allows low-privileged authenticated users to retrieve any user's stored password value. Attackers can decrypt the AES-CBC protected response using the hard-coded key exposed by /sys/getEncryptedString to obtain administrators' password ciphertexts for offline guessing.

title: Wukong AICRM through 20260610 Authorization Bypass via User-Controlled Session ID in POST /chat/send
desc: Wukong AICRM through 20260610 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write into other users' AI chat sessions by supplying an arbitrary sessionId to POST /chat/send. Attackers can append messages to a victim's conversation and receive streamed assistant replies built from the victim's last 20 messages, disclosing conversation content.

title: ConvertX through 0.19.0 Arbitrary File Read via Pandoc Converter
desc: ConvertX through 0.19.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read server files because src/converters/pandoc.ts invokes Pandoc without the --sandbox flag. Attackers can upload a reStructuredText document with an include directive naming an absolute path, convert it, and download output containing the referenced file's contents.

title: CordysCRM through 1.9.3 Missing Authorization and Blind SSRF via Webhook Test
desc: 1Panel-dev CordysCRM through 1.9.3 lacks a PROCESS_SETTING permission check on POST /approval-flow/webhook/test, allowing any authenticated user to trigger server-side requests to attacker-supplied URLs. Attackers can redirect GET requests from a controlled host to bypass SSRFValidator and probe internal addresses through success or failure results.

title: Wukong_HRM through commit 186115e Authentication Bypass via ParamAspect
desc: Wukong_HRM through commit 186115e contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ParamAspect that allows unauthenticated attackers to call every HRM API endpoint by omitting the AUTH-TOKEN header. Attackers gain HR administrator access to read payslips, salary history and employee personal data, download attachments, and modify or delete company-wide HR records.

title: SuiteCRM through 7.15.2 and 8.10.2 Missing Authorization via setCampaignMarketingAndTemplate
desc: SuiteCRM through 7.15.2 and 8.x through 8.10.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create and modify EmailMarketing records via the setCampaignMarketingAndTemplate entry point. Low-privileged users denied Campaigns access can post marketingId, campaignId, and templateId to reattach marketing messages or swap the template EmailMan sends in campaign emai

title: Rill 0.77.0 through 0.90.5 OAuth Missing Authorization via Dynamic Client Registration
desc: Rill 0.77.0 through 0.90.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the admin OAuth server that issues authorization codes to dynamically registered clients without user consent. Attackers can register a client with the long_lived_access_token scope and lure a user to an authorization link, obtaining a non-expiring API token with the user's full permissions.

title: answer-me-with-html through 0.5.0 Symlink Following in Code Block src Embedding
desc: answer-me-with-html through 0.5.0 contains a link following vulnerability in the am CLI code block src= embedding, where localPath() checks only path text without resolving symlinks. Attackers can ship a repository with a symlink pointing outside the checkout so am render embeds readable external files into generated HTML, disclosing them when shared.

title: Flyte 2.0.1 through 2.0.51 Cleartext Secret Exposure via Admission Webhook
desc: Flyte 2.0.1 through 2.0.51 contains a cleartext secret storage vulnerability that allows users with Pod read access to obtain secrets by reading init container environment variables. The embedded secret manager webhook writes base64-encoded FILE-mounted secret values into the SECRETS environment variable, letting principals without Secret store access decode them from the Pod spec.

title: Frappe HR (hrms) before 16.11.0 Missing Authorization via expire_allocation
desc: Frappe HR (hrms) before 16.11.0, including all 14.x and 15.x releases through 15.64.3, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the whitelisted expire_allocation method that allows authenticated users to expire any leave allocation. Attackers without HR roles can name another employee's Leave Allocation in a POST request to zero its allocated leaves and wipe that employee's remaining leav

title: Traccar 5.7 through 6.16.0 Login CSRF via OpenID Connect Callback
desc: Traccar 5.7 through 6.16.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to log victims into attacker-controlled accounts because the OpenID Connect callback never validates the OAuth state parameter. Attackers can induce a victim's browser to load /api/session/openid/callback with their own authorization code, causing data the victim enters, such as registered devices,

title: pbi-cli 3.10.1 through 3.12.0 OS Command Injection via Desktop Sync
desc: pbi-cli 3.10.1 through 3.12.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in desktop_sync.py that passes unquoted .pbip paths to cmd /c start when reopening projects. Attackers can lure victims into opening a Power BI project from a space-free path containing & to run commands with victim privileges during report write or reload.

title: GPT-Load through 1.4.11 Cleartext Proxy Key Logging via Access Logger
desc: GPT-Load through 1.4.11 contains a cleartext logging vulnerability that exposes client proxy keys because the Gin Logger middleware records the raw query string before extractAuthKey strips the key parameter. Attackers with read access to console logs or ./data/logs/app.log can recover proxy keys from Gemini-style requests and use them against the corresponding group.

title: mistral.rs 0.9.0 through 0.9.4 Sandbox Escape via Symlink Following in mistralrs-code-exec
desc: mistral.rs 0.9.0 through 0.9.4 contains a link following vulnerability in mistralrs-code-exec that allows sandboxed shell code to read and overwrite files outside the sandbox via symlinks. Attackers or prompt-injected agents can name symlinks as outputs or reuse sessions with symlinked input paths to access files with the server process's permissions.

title: thClaws through 0.141.0 Symlink Following File Write via POST /v1/inputs
desc: thClaws through 0.141.0 contains a link-following vulnerability in the post_inputs handler of the v1 API POST /v1/inputs endpoint that allows writes outside the workspace by following symlinks. Attackers who plant a symlink under the allowed inputs/ prefix can cause later authenticated uploads to write or truncate files outside the workspace with daemon privileges.

title: Wanwu before 0.6.3 IDOR AppKey Deletion via DELETE /v1/appspace/app/key
desc: Wanwu before 0.6.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows any authenticated enabled user to delete other users' legacy AppKeys by supplying a numeric apiId. Attackers can iterate sequential key IDs against DELETE /v1/appspace/app/key to revoke AppKeys across organizations, breaking MCP and OpenAPI clients until owners issue new keys.

title: mcp-go through 1.2.1 Denial of Service via Unbounded POST Body Buffering
desc: mcp-go through 1.2.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in StreamableHTTPServer.ServeHTTP that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending oversized POST bodies. Attackers can send arbitrarily large or many concurrent POST requests, read fully via io.ReadAll before validation, to degrade or OOM-kill the server process.

title: iFlytek Astron Agent through 1.1.2 Authorization Bypass via /workflow/v1/resume Endpoint
desc: iFlytek Astron Agent through 1.1.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated applications to resume other applications' paused workflows by supplying their event_id to POST /workflow/v1/resume. Attackers can predict Snowflake event IDs to inject resume content into victim workflows and read their continuation output stream, breaking cross-tenant isolation

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/api/sendSysAnnouncement
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to send system announcements by calling POST /sys/api/sendSysAnnouncement. Attackers can supply arbitrary title, content, fromUser and toUser values to deliver forged announcements to any users via WebSocket, WeCom, DingTalk and Feishu.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/user/changeDepartChargePerson
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to assign or remove department heads by calling PUT /sys/user/changeDepartChargePerson. Low-privileged attackers can supply arbitrary userId, department id, and status values to make any user a department head, widening department-scoped views, or demote existing heads.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 IDOR via /airag/api/getChatVariable Username Parameter
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in AiragBaseApiController that allows authenticated users to read other users' AI chat variables via the username parameter. Attackers can send POST requests to /airag/api/getChatVariable with a target appId, username, and variable name to retrieve stored chat memory values from Redis.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via sysMessageTemplate Delete Endpoint
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysMessageTemplateController delete handler that allows any authenticated user to delete message templates. Low-privileged attackers can obtain template ids from the unguarded list endpoint and delete shipped notification templates, causing system notices and workflow reminders to fail.

title: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 Missing Authorization via /sys/user/getUserDetailByUserId
desc: JeecgBoot through 3.9.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the SysUserController getUserDetailByUserId handler that allows any authenticated user to read other users' details. Low-privileged attackers can supply arbitrary userId values to retrieve real names, usernames, emails, phone numbers, birthdays, employee numbers, department paths and posts.

title: Open Source Social Network (OSSN) through 10.1 Missing Authorization via Album Photo Routes
desc: Open Source Social Network (OSSN) through 10.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ossn_album_page_handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to download files via album/getphoto and album/getcover. Attackers can enumerate sequential file GUIDs to retrieve friends-only album photos and other stored files without any access check.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Authorization Bypass via purchaseStatus in /depotHead/list
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users restricted to personal or department data to list other users' bills by adding a purchaseStatus value. Attackers can include purchaseStatus=0 in the search JSON on GET /depotHead/list, causing DepotHeadService.select to drop the creator filter and expose all tenant purchase, sales and inventory bills.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Mass Assignment via PUT /user/update
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the UserController update handler that allows authenticated users to overwrite protected fields including tenant_id and password. Attackers can send a crafted PUT /user/update body to switch into another tenant on next login or overwrite other users' password hashes for account takeover.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Code Injection via Velocity sendAsEmail Template
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute OS commands by submitting Velocity templates in DocumentService.sendAsEmail subject or message fields. Attackers can invoke SystemTool exec methods or ClassTool, bypassing the forbidRuntimeUsage denylist, to run commands with LogicalDOC process privileges.

title: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 Forced Password Reset via Unbound PswRecovery Ticket
desc: LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the PswRecovery servlet that fails to bind password recovery tickets to the requesting user. Attackers can obtain a ticket for their own account and reuse it with any userId, including administrators, to reset victims' passwords, lock them out, and reveal their email addresses.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 NULL Dereference in Video Redirection Channel
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the client video redirection channel that allows malicious servers to crash clients by sending out-of-order messages. Attackers can send a Geometry CLEAR message that nulls presentation->geometry, then send VideoData that dereferences it, causing client denial of service.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in GIF Encoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the GIF encoder because allocated memory is not released when color quantization fails during encoding. Attackers can supply images whose GIF conversion causes quantization to fail, leaking memory with each attempt and degrading availability.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Code Injection via CIP Encoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an XML injection vulnerability in the CIP encoder, which does not properly escape input-derived data when writing Cisco IP Phone XML output. Attackers can supply a crafted file that, when converted to CIP format, injects arbitrary markup into the generated XML.

title: ImageMagick 7.1.2-30 before 7.1.2-32 Use After Free in WBINFO Decoder
desc: ImageMagick 7.1.2-30 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the WBINFO decoder that occurs when a memory allocation fails during image decoding. Attackers can supply a crafted image that, when decoded under memory allocation failure conditions, causes freed memory to be reused, crashing the application.

title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Temporary File Leak in JNG Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an incomplete cleanup flaw in the JNG decoder that fails to remove temporary files when processing crafted input. Attackers can submit crafted JNG files for processing to repeatedly leak temporary files, consuming disk space and degrading availability.

title: Open WebUI 0.6.33 before 0.11.4 Stored XSS via Citation embed_url
desc: Open WebUI from 0.6.33 before 0.11.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute script in victims' sessions by storing javascript: URLs in citation embed_url fields. Attackers can share a crafted chat whose citation, when clicked, is passed to window.open, letting them steal localStorage.token and act as the victim.

title: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 Missing Authorization via Backend Index on Model Routes
desc: Open WebUI before 0.11.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach disabled model provider backends by supplying an explicit backend index. Attackers can pass the index as a path segment or query parameter on Ollama and OpenAI-compatible listing routes to trigger requests carrying configured API keys, read version strings, and enumerate connections.

title: Parse Server before 8.6.95 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2-alpha.3 Denial of Service via File Pointer Without URL
desc: Parse Server before 8.6.95 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2-alpha.3 does not resolve file references lacking a URL before passing objects to Cloud Code triggers and LiveQuery, causing an uncaught exception that terminates the process. title: Craft CMS 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 Missing Authorization via app/switch-to-licensed-edition
desc: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in AppController::actionSwitchToLicensedEdition() that lets any authenticated user change the installed edition. Low-privileged front-end users can call the action route when the licensed edition mismatches to persistently downgrade the site edition in project config, which admins cannot reverse from the control pan

title: vLLM before 0.29.0 Heap Overflow DoS via IAMF Audio Transcription Upload
desc: vLLM before 0.29.0 passes uploaded audio to the PyAV/FFmpeg av.open() fallback with only a file-size check, exposing FFmpeg's IAMF parser heap overflow. Authenticated remote attackers can repeatedly upload malformed IAMF containers to /v1/audio/transcriptions, corrupting the heap and crashing the API process.

title: Grav Data Manager 1.4.0 through 1.4.5 Unauthenticated File Deletion via Admin
desc: Grav Data Manager plugin 1.4.0 through 1.4.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to delete stored data files via the classic Admin integration. Attackers can send a request with the delete parameter and known data type and filename to remove files under user/data/, including form submissions, or forge requests lacking CSRF nonce checks.

title: Grav Login OAuth Plugin before 1.4.3 Predictable Local Credentials Authentication Bypass
desc: Grav Login OAuth plugin (grav-plugin-login-oauth) before 1.4.3 provisions OAuth accounts as ordinary Grav users with a deterministic <provider>.<id> username and an unsalted MD5 hash of the provider identifier as the password, without disabling password login. title: Grav before 2.1.7 Information Disclosure via Nested .git Directories
desc: Grav before 2.1.7 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because bundled nginx, lighttpd, IIS, and Caddy 2 configurations block .git only at document root. Unauthenticated attackers can request nested repositories such as user/.git to retrieve Git config, refs, and objects, reconstructing unpublished history or committed secrets.

title: QloApps through 1.7.0 Insecure Direct Object Reference in Back-Office AJAX Handlers
desc: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in back-office AJAX handlers of AdminOrdersController, AdminBookingDocumentController, AdminProductsController and AdminAddHotelController that skip htl_access hotel checks. Hotel-restricted employees can supply other hotels' sequential identifiers to read, upload and delete booking documents and delete rooms, room im

title: SWUpdate through 2026.05.1 CMS Signature Verification Bypass via Embedded Intermediates
desc: SWUpdate through 2026.05.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in crypto/swupdate_cms_verify_openssl.c that trusts untrusted X.509 certificates embedded in CMS SignedData for chain building. Attackers holding a signing key from a sibling intermediate under the same root can embed that intermediate in the signature to install malicious updates.

title: Frappe before 15.113.3 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Record Modification
desc: Frappe before 15.113.3 and 16.x before 16.25.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated users can send requests to these endpoints to modify records beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: ERPNext before 15.112.0 Stored XSS via Tool View Record Names
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 and 16.x before 16.23.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because a tool view interpolates stored record names into markup without escaping. An authenticated user able to create such records can give them malicious names, executing script in the session of any user who later opens that tool.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.120.0 Stored XSS via Report View
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in a report view that interpolates stored record names into markup without escaping. Authenticated users able to create records can store crafted record names that execute script in the session of any user who later opens the report.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Missing Authorization in Record Creation Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks during document creation. Authenticated low-privileged users can send requests to these endpoints to create documents against records beyond their permitted role, bypassing role-based permission restrictions.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 Missing Authorization Exposes Financial Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.3 and 16.x before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce role-based authorization checks. Authenticated users can request these endpoints to read financial data beyond the permissions granted by their assigned role.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 Missing Authorization in Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in which certain endpoints fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated attackers can call these endpoints to read data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.105.0 Missing Authorization in Document Creation Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.105.0 and 16.x before 16.15.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain document creation endpoints that fail to verify that the requesting portal user belongs to the target party. Authenticated portal users can send requests to these endpoints to create documents on behalf of parties other than their own.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 16.22.0 Missing Authorization Allows Unauthorized Record Modification
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 16.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify records by invoking endpoints lacking proper authorization checks. Attackers can call these endpoints to perform operations on records beyond their permitted role, resulting in unauthorized modification of data.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 Unauthorized Record Creation via Missing Authorization
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.31.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated attackers can send requests to these endpoints to create records and modify data beyond their permitted role, bypassing intended role-based access restrictions.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 Missing Authorization Exposes Personal Data
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 and 16.x before 16.23.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper authorization checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can send requests to these endpoints to read personal data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.115.0 Missing Authorization in Inventory Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.115.0 and 16.x before 16.26.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper role-based authorization checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can send requests to these endpoints to modify inventory records beyond their permitted role.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 Missing Authorization in Production Record Endpoints
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.112.0 and 16.x before 16.23.0 has certain endpoints that do not enforce proper authorization checks on operations that modify production records. An authenticated low-privileged user can send requests to these endpoints to modify production data beyond what their assigned role permits.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.108.0 Missing Authorization Allows Master Record Deactivation
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.108.0 and 16.x before 16.18.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain endpoints that fail to enforce proper permission checks. Authenticated low-privileged users can call these endpoints to deactivate master records, modifying data beyond their permitted role.

title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 Stored XSS via Item Record Name
desc: Frappe ERPNext before 15.110.0 and 16.x before 16.21.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability caused by record names being rendered without escaping. Attackers with write access to item master data can store malicious script in a record name that executes in the browser of any operator who opens the affected page.

title: Frappe Suite before commit 2697564 Broken Access Control in Mail Mailbox and Quota APIs
desc: Frappe Suite before commit 2697564a9c46da6acc614743eaf9915fe5238f4f contains a broken access control vulnerability in the get_mailboxes and get_quota APIs that allows authenticated mail users to access other users' data. Attackers can supply another user's JMAP account ID to read mailbox names, message counts, automation rules with sender addresses, and storage quota usage.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta4 before 3.32.0 NULL Pointer Crash via ARM Response
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0-beta4 before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference in arm_handle_request_ok when an ARM endpoint returns an empty HTTP 200 body. Attackers controlling the configured ARM gateway can return a zero-length body to pass NULL to strnlen and crash the connecting client.

title: FreeRDP 2.3.0 before 3.32.0 Infinite Loop via RD Gateway Chunked Response
desc: FreeRDP from 2.3.0 before 3.32.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in http_chuncked_read that allows malicious RD Gateways to hang clients by sending incomplete chunked responses. Attackers can send a partial chunk-size line or footer followed by a clean TLS shutdown, causing zero-byte reads to loop forever and freeze the client decoder thread.

title: FreeRDP 3.11.0 before 3.32.0 Reachable Assertion via AVC444 Odd Region Width
desc: FreeRDP 3.11.0 before 3.32.0 does not validate that AVC444 and AVC444v2 region widths are even before YUV444 conversion, so an odd width reaches an assertion and aborts the client. A malicious or compromised RDP server can terminate a connected FreeRDP client after RDPGFX AVC444 negotiation by sending an in-bounds region rectangle with an odd width.

title: FreeRDP 3.17.1 before 3.32.0 Heap Buffer Over-Read via Proxy DRDYNVC Channel Name
desc: FreeRDP 3.17.1 before 3.32.0 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in DynvcTrackerHandleCreateBack of the freerdp-proxy DRDYNVC channel handler that allows malicious backend RDP servers to read heap memory out of bounds. Attackers can send a CREATE_REQUEST_PDU whose channel name lacks a NUL byte, causing an unbounded snprintf read that leaks memory into proxy logs or crashes the process.

title: jshERP through 3.6 Missing Authorization via /user/batchSetStatus
desc: jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /user/batchSetStatus endpoint that allows authenticated low-privilege users to change other users' account status. Attackers can submit crafted ids and status values to disable every non-owner account in their tenant, locking out administrators, or re-enable disabled accounts.

title: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.0 HTTP Header Injection via Proxy Routing Token

title: BMC Helix Network Management before 26.3.01 Authentication Bypass via SAML Configuration
desc: BMC Helix Network Management on-prem before 26.3.01 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as the local administrator with any password when SAML single sign-on is configured. title: Frappe HRMS 14.0.0 before 14.38.2 SQL Injection via Missing Validation
desc: Frappe HRMS 14.x before 14.38.2, 15.x before 15.64.0, and 16.x before 16.18.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in some endpoints caused by missing input validation. Any authenticated attacker, including a low-privilege account, can send specially crafted requests to these endpoints to extract sensitive information from the database.

title: Antiword through 0.37 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via vGet8LstInfo in prop8.c
desc: Antiword through 0.37 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in vGet8LstInfo in prop8.c caused by an inverted bounds check on the PlcfLst record count. Attackers can supply a crafted Word 8 .doc file claiming up to 0xffff LSTF records in a tiny buffer, causing reads past the heap allocation that crash the process.

desc: phpMyFAQ 3.2.0-alpha before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows IdP-authenticated users to skip TOTP two-factor authentication through the Keycloak and Entra ID SSO callbacks. title: smpeg through 2.0.0 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via MPEGsystem::FillBuffer
desc: smpeg through 2.0.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in MPEGsystem::FillBuffer() that allows attackers to read past the 16384-byte buffer by supplying a crafted system header stream table. Attackers can provide an MPEG file whose stream table bytes all set the high bit, which crashes applications opening it through SMPEG_new, SMPEG_new_rwops, or SMPEG_new_data.

title: smpeg through 2.0.0 Integer Underflow via stream_header in MPEGsystem.cpp
desc: smpeg through 2.0.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in stream_header() in MPEGsystem.cpp that allows attackers to wrap packet_size by declaring an undersized packet length. Attackers can supply a crafted MPEG file opened via SMPEG_new, SMPEG_new_rwops or SMPEG_new_data to trigger a reachable assertion or out-of-bounds copy, crashing the application.

title: Omnigent 0.3.0 before 0.14.0 Path Traversal via Sub-Agent os_env.cwd
desc: Omnigent 0.3.0 before 0.14.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to escape the workspace by setting os_env.cwd on nested sub-agents. Attackers can upload a bundle whose sub-agent uses an absolute or parent-traversing working directory, bypassing root-only validation in bundles.py, to read and write host files as the runner user.

title: Omnispace Agora Project < 26.10.0 Insecure Remember-Me Token Storage
desc: Omnispace Agora Project before 26.10.0 contains a vulnerability where the persistent remember-me token is stored verbatim server-side, making the stored value identical to the bearer credential held in the user's cookie. desc: Omnispace Agora Project before 26.10.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the calendar functionality that allows attackers to inject malicious SQL by manipulating the sortEvents parameter, which is concatenated into the ORDER BY clause without sanitization in app/ModCalendar/CtrlCalendar.php. desc: Omnispace Agora Project before 26.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to persist unneutralized markup by submitting malicious values as two-dimensional POST arrays through the LDAP/person import flow, bypassing the paramsFilter() request parameter filter which failed to recurse into nested arrays. Attackers can inject arbitrary script code

title: Omnispace Agora Project < 26.10.0 Broken Function-Level Authorization via User-Edit
desc: Omnispace Agora Project before 26.10.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows a regular, non-administrative member to create user accounts by invoking the user-edit action without a function-level authorization check. Attackers can exploit the missing editRight() enforcement in actionVueEditUser to create unauthorized user accounts, leading to privilege escalation.

title: Wazuh 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 RBAC Authorization Bypass via /security/actions
desc: Wazuh from 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read the RBAC catalog by querying unprotected security endpoints. Attackers can request GET /security/actions and /security/resources, which omit the caller's RBAC policies, to map privileged actions and endpoints for privilege escalation planning.

desc: Wazuh 4.0.0 before 4.14.8 fails to invalidate issued tokens for run_as users with zero static roles, because check_token never consults the blacklist. Attackers with revoked administrator grants can continue authenticating and self-link the administrator role to permanently retain privileged access.

desc: The European VAT Compliance Assistant for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via CF-IPCountry Header in all versions up to, and including, 1.36.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Remote attackers can submit high-resolution videos to /v1/chat/completions on Qwen-VL deployments, and concurrent requests exhaust worker memory causing denial of service.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 Out-of-Bounds Write via MS-RDPEGT Video Geometry
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 stores the server-supplied signed MS-RDPEGT geometry origin unchecked in an unsigned video surface coordinate, so the blit clamp in gdiVideoShowSurface() wraps in 32-bit arithmetic and is skipped. title: FreeRDP 3.10.0 through 3.32.2 Heap Buffer Overflow in WinPR PNG Conversion

title: Open WebUI 0.7.0 before 0.11.4 Session Token Theft via SyncStatsModal

Attackers can fetch protected forms, extract the captcha_image value with a pattern match, and submit it to automate spam, registrations, reviews, and account deletion requests.

title: ValueCell through 0.1.20 Unauthenticated SSRF via /api/v1/models/check
desc: ValueCell through 0.1.20 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to direct backend requests by setting an unvalidated provider base_url. Attackers can set base_url via the provider config endpoint and trigger POST /api/v1/models/check to reach internal or metadata addresses, read error responses, and capture stored provider API keys.

title: TaskingAI through 0.3.0 SSRF via OpenAPI servers[0].url in Actions
desc: TaskingAI through 0.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to make the backend send arbitrary HTTP requests by supplying an unvalidated OpenAPI servers[0].url in a user-defined action. Attackers holding a project API key or console admin login can create an action pointing to loopback, internal or cloud metadata addresses and run it via POST /a

title: Trudesk through 1.2.11 Authorization Bypass via GET /api/v1/messages/conversation/:id
desc: Trudesk through 1.2.11 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read private conversations by supplying another conversation's id. Attackers can request GET /api/v1/messages/conversation/:id, which lacks participant checks, to obtain full message history plus participants' usernames, full names and email addresses.

title: zhontai Admin.Core through 10.1.0 Authorization Bypass via User and Organization By-ID Endpoints
desc: zhontai Admin.Core through 10.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to ignore department DataScope restrictions by supplying out-of-scope record ids. Attackers holding user or organization module permissions with Dept or Self scope can call UserService and OrgService by-id methods to read, modify, disable, and delete users in other departments.

desc: Ivanti Connect Secure 22.8R2.4 mishandles the manner in which the dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, leading to privilege escalation to root, as exploited in the wild in October 2026.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 NULL Dereference via Zero-Length WebSocket Ping
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the websocket transport that allows a malicious gateway to crash clients by sending zero-length pings. When the payload length is zero, websocket_reply_pong passes a nullptr stream to websocket_reply_close, triggering an assertion failure that terminates the client process and causes denial of service.

title: FreeRDP from 3.30.0 before 3.32.0 Resource Exhaustion via rdpecam StartStreamsRequest
desc: FreeRDP from 3.30.0 before 3.32.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the rdpecam client that lets malicious RDP servers request unadvertised camera media types. Attackers can send a StartStreamsRequest with oversized dimensions to force large pending-sample allocations and reconfigure the local camera through the HAL.

title: FreeRDP 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 Memory Exhaustion via Static Channel Reassembly
desc: FreeRDP from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contains an unbounded reassembly vulnerability in WTSProcessChannelData that fails to enforce cumulative fragment limits. Authenticated clients can start a static virtual channel message, withhold the LAST flag, and send endless fragments to exhaust server memory.

title: Nezha 1.7.0 before 2.3.15 Cross-Tenant Server-ID Enumeration via getServerConfig
desc: Nezha from 1.7.0 before 2.3.15 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated members to enumerate other tenants' server IDs through differential responses. Attackers can sweep sequential IDs against getServerConfig and setServerConfig, distinguishing 'permission denied' from success payloads to map other users' servers.

title: Nezha 2.2.5 before 2.3.15 Information Disclosure via DDNS List Endpoint
desc: Nezha from 2.2.5 before 2.3.15 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retrieve third-party credentials because listDDNS omits WebhookURL and WebhookRequestBody redaction. Admins or PATs with nezha:ddns:read scope can call GET /api/v1/ddns to read cleartext tokens embedded in every user's DDNS webhook profiles.

title: Frappe before 16.33.0 restrict_ip Allowlist Bypass via API Key, OAuth Authentication
desc: Frappe Framework before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 does not enforce the per-user restrict_ip allowlist for non-session authentication methods, including API key, OAuth, and header-based authentication. Attackers holding valid credentials of these types can authenticate from IP addresses outside the allowlist, defeating the configured network-based access restrictions.

title: SGLang 0.5.10 through 0.5.22 Code Injection via Debug Dumper Filter
desc: SGLang 0.5.10 through 0.5.22 contains a code injection vulnerability in _evaluate_filter() that allows remote attackers to execute Python code by escaping the eval() sandbox through re.search __globals__. Attackers can send a crafted filter expression to the unauthenticated /dumper/configure endpoint when DUMPER_SERVER_PORT is set, running code in the scheduler process on the next forward pass.

title: WordPress Advanced Post Manager plugin <= 4.5.6 - Broken Access Control vulnerability
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP Advanced Post Manager advanced-post-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Advanced Post Manager: from n/a through 4.5.6.

title: WordPress YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce plugin <= 1.61.0 - Broken Access Control vulnerability
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in YITH YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce yith-paypal-express-checkout-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.61.0.

desc: Wheels CLI 4.0.0 through 4.1.1 insufficiently validates or escapes caller-supplied values and package contents. The allocation size is computed as strlen(b64) + strlen(hex) + 31, but the format string "fan1:x509:server:passive:%s:sha256:%s" contains 33 fixed characters in addition to the two variable-length fields and a null terminator, requiring strlen(b64) + strlen(hex)

title: Libblockdev: libblockdev: argument injection in ntfs/vfat label-setting helpers via udisks2 setlabel() d-bus method
desc: A flaw was found in libblockdev. The bd_fs_ntfs_set_label() and bd_fs_vfat_set_label() functions pass caller-supplied label values as bare positional arguments to the ntfslabel and fatlabel utilities without end-of-options separators or input validation for values beginning with a dash. title: roncoo-education through 25.0.0-RELEASE IDOR via Order Pay Cancel and Continue Endpoints
desc: roncoo-education through 25.0.0-RELEASE contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to cancel or continue payment on other users' orders. Attackers can supply another user's order number to the pay cancel or continue endpoints to close pending orders or read course ids and prices.

title: smart-sso through 2.1.1 OAuth2 Authorization Code Theft via Unvalidated redirectUri
desc: smart-sso through 2.1.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the /login handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to steal OAuth2 authorization codes by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter. Attackers can send crafted /login links to users with active SSO sessions, then redeem stolen codes at /oauth2/access_token with any valid client credentials to obtain victims' access token

title: Distributor before 2.3.2 Missing Authorization in External Connection AJAX Actions
desc: Distributor before 2.3.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to invoke external connection AJAX actions intended for manage_options users. Attackers can call dt_verify_external_connection with a chosen endpointId and url to send stored connection credentials to attacker-controlled servers, or abuse dt_begin_authorization to create connections.

title: NexoPOS through 6.2.4 Unauthenticated Transaction Disclosure via /api/fields Endpoint
desc: NexoPOS through 6.2.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read accounting transaction records via GET /api/fields/{resource}/{identifier}. Attackers can request transaction field classes like ns.entity-transaction with sequential ids to retrieve names, values, account ids, and descriptions without nexopos.read.transactions permission.

title: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 Authentication Bypass via Auto-Login Endpoints
desc: FastapiAdmin through 3.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain sessions for any user by abusing unprotected auto-login endpoints. Attackers can list users via /api/v1/auth/auto-login/users, mint a superuser auto-login token, and exchange it for a JWT session to gain full administrative control.

title: SurveyKing before 1.13.0 Unauthenticated File Download via /api/public/preview
desc: SurveyKing before 1.13.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download any stored file by id through GET /api/public/preview/{attachmentId}. Attackers who know or derive time-ordered snowflake file ids can bypass shared, owner, and project checks in FileServiceImpl.loadFile to read private survey attachments and respondent uploads.

title: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 Unauthenticated SSRF via /oembed Endpoint
desc: Chaskiq through 2.0.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the url parameter of the /oembed endpoint. Attackers can target loopback, private, or cloud-metadata addresses through FetchLinkCardService, which follows redirects and skips TLS verification, to read internal page titles and descriptions.

title: EFAK through 5.1.0 Privilege Escalation via /api/users REST API
desc: EFAK through 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to manage accounts because the /api/users endpoints lack administrator role checks. Attackers can send POST, PUT, or DELETE requests to UserController to grant themselves ROLE_ADMIN, create administrators, or delete users, gaining control of managed Kafka clusters.

title: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 IDOR via hcp-mp Member and Order APIs
desc: HUIZHI ChargeOS cloud through 3.0.9 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the hcp-mp MeController and OrderController that trusts client-supplied userId, openId and orderNumber parameters. Attackers can enumerate sequential member ids against endpoints like /me/getMemberBalanceByUserId and /order/orderDetail to read any member's wallet, credit, profile and charging orders.

title: OtterMind Nubase through 0.1.4 Missing Authentication in Storage Object API
desc: OtterMind Nubase through 0.1.4 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private bucket objects because /storage/v1/object/{bucketId}/{path} is treated as public for every HTTP method. Attackers knowing a tenant subdomain, bucket id and object path can download objects from private buckets and delete stored objects without an apikey or JWT.

title: ChatOllama through commit 96c3ce5 IDOR Exposes Private Knowledge Bases
desc: ChatOllama through commit 96c3ce5 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows remote attackers to access other users' private knowledge bases by supplying sequential ids. Attackers can enumerate ids via GET /api/knowledgebases/{id} or the knowledgebaseId parameter of POST /api/models/chat to read metadata and retrieved document content.

title: 99AI through 4.3.0 Unauthenticated Information Disclosure via chatLog exportExcel
desc: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /api/chatLog/exportExcel route that allows unauthenticated attackers to export all users' chat logs. Attackers can send requests with controlled page, size, and optional email fields to download xlsx files containing usernames, emails, prompts, and AI answers.

title: 99AI through 4.3.0 IDOR via /api/chatLog/querySingleChat Chat Message Disclosure
desc: 99AI through 4.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read other users' chat messages because querySingleChat lacks an owner check. Attackers can send a fingerprint header to obtain a visitor JWT and iterate sequential chatId values to retrieve other users' message content and task data.

title: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 Pre-Auth Stack Overflow via Boa user_ok()
desc: Netcore NR256CN through 1.5.140116 contains a pre-authentication stack overflow vulnerability in the Boa web server's user_ok() function, which copies Basic-auth usernames with unbounded strcpy() calls into 64-byte stack buffers. Unauthenticated attackers can send a username longer than 63 bytes to any protected /router/*.cgi route to crash the main Boa process or potentially execute code.

title: Arkon through 0.9.2 Broken Access Control via Sources By-ID Routes
desc: Arkon through 0.9.2 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to read and modify other departments' sources because by-id routes in app/routers/sources.py skip can_access_document. Attackers can call the plan, progress, PATCH, retry and approve-extraction routes with foreign source IDs to disclose derived wiki titles and summaries and alter ingestion state.

title: Open WES through 1.0.0 Broken Access Control via GlobalGatewayFilter Warehouse Scoping
desc: Open WES through 1.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to modify other warehouses' stock records because GlobalGatewayFilter never enforces auth_warehouse scoping. Attackers holding the menu permission can enumerate sequential IDs on freezeContainerStock and unfreezeContainerStock endpoints to freeze or unfreeze container stock in other warehouses.

title: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability in Certain NETGEAR RAX Series Models
desc: An authentication bypass vulnerability in the listed NETGEAR RAX series models allows an unauthenticated attacker with adjacent access to the affected device’s management service to access certain device information or modify administrative settings. This vulnerability may impact the confidentiality and integrity of management data and the availability of device-management functions.

title: Improper Authorization in Divasoft Software's Biletiva Ticketing Platform
desc:
Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security vulnerability in Divasoft Software and E-Commerce Inc. Biletiva Ticketing Platform allows Manipulating State.

This issue affects Biletiva Ticketing Platform: through 2026-07-23.

title: IDOR in SFM Software's Costifier
desc:
Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in SFM Software Technologies Inc. Costifier allows Exploitation of Trusted Identifiers.

This issue affects Costifier: through 2026-10-16.  NOTE: The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: IBM i is Affected By Improper Authorization and Access Control Vulnerabilities in Network File System
desc: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a local attacker to bypass NFS version restrictions due to improper enforcement of the export version flag.

title: IBM i is Affected by an Improper Validation Vulnerability
desc: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a remote attacker to perform unauthorized manipulation of distributed transactions due to improper validation of attacker-supplied transaction identifiers.

title: Mattermost guest account privilege escalation via member roles API
desc: Mattermost versions 11.10.x <= 11.10.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.9, 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5 fail to validate the combination of guest and admin scheme roles which allows an authenticated attacker to escalate a guest account to team or channel admin via a crafted PUT request to the member roles API endpoint.. title: Private channel ID disclosure via user status endpoints
desc: Mattermost versions 11.9.x <= 11.9.1, 11.8.x <= 11.8.5, 11.7.x <= 11.7.10, 11.10.x <= 11.10.1 fail to sanitize the active channel field returned by the user status API endpoints, which allows an authenticated user to learn the channel ID of a private channel another user is actively viewing via the status endpoints, without being a member of that channel.
